issuer: 立讯精密工业股份有限公司

exact_rule_used.required_behavior: Before upgrading on scale or revenue growth, build a responsibility-matched bridge to recurring profit, unit economics, utilization, inventory absorption, or an equivalent economic carrier; preserve independently supported company judgments when one bridge remains open.

v3_treatment.trigger_observed_preoutcome: FY2023 consolidated revenue rose 8.35% and attributable profit rose 19.53%; consumer electronics, 85.03% of sales, grew 9.75%. FY2023 operating cash flow also rose 116.89% to RMB27.605bn.
v3_treatment.responsibility_matched_bridge: The FY2023 report says the cash-flow increase came from faster customer collection and sale/collection of opening strategic inventory. Consumer-electronics gross margin was 10.60%, down 0.87 percentage points year on year. Those observations support delivered volume and inventory absorption, but do not establish that the cash uplift is a recurring owner-cash level or that the core unit economics improved.
v3_treatment.enhanced_treatment: Retain positive credit for delivery and inventory absorption; keep recurring owner cash and the associated permanent-loss protection CONDITIONAL pending a second-period cash and margin bridge. Do not use the FY2023 cash jump to lower the concentration-and-asset-utilization permanent-loss concern.

material_difference_relative_to_ordinary.comparison_boundary: This is a counterfactual ordinary-research treatment, not a characterization of the unread baseline work product.
material_difference_relative_to_ordinary.ordinary_treatment_being_avoided: Treating the FY2023 profit and cash acceleration as an unqualified improvement in recurring owner cash and therefore as reduced permanent-loss exposure.
material_difference_relative_to_ordinary.enhanced_difference: The enhanced judgment separates validated operating execution from an unvalidated recurring cash level. It consequently leaves owner-cash strength conditional and preserves customer concentration plus manufacturing-asset utilization as a material permanent-loss carrier.
material_difference_relative_to_ordinary.why_material: The difference changes the treatment of the two investor-relevant questions that the FY2023 headline cash figure would otherwise answer: whether cash available after reinvestment is durable, and whether a customer/program reversal could strand a large manufacturing asset base. It is not a difference in prose, field count, or caveat volume.

v3_treatment.falsifiable_observation: The enhanced pause is falsified if the FY2024 annual report, on the same disclosed bases, shows consumer-electronics revenue at least RMB197.183bn, consumer-electronics gross margin at least 10.60%, and operating cash flow at least attributable profit while operating cash flow less cash paid for long-lived assets remains positive. That would provide the missing second-period recurring-economics bridge despite the FY2023 working-capital explanation.
